6. Email Studio — User Manual

6.1 What is the Email Studio?

The Email Studio is the central building block for all email templates in the ABpE Portal. All automated emails — whether notifications about completed consultant profiles, upload confirmations, or pipeline status messages — are sent exclusively via the Email Studio. No module sends emails directly, but always through this central interface.

The Studio can be accessed via the menu item Email Studio in the left sidebar. It consists of four areas: Templates (Overview), Studio / Editor (Create and Edit), Send Log (Protocol), and Configuration (Administrators only).

6.2 Template Overview

The start page shows all existing email templates in a table, grouped by app area. For each template, the name, identifier, sender mode, HTML/TXT status, version, and last use are displayed.

Actions per template:

  • ✏ Edit — Open template in Studio
  • 📋 Duplicate — Create a complete independent copy
  • 👁 Preview — Email preview without opening
  • ✈ Send Test — Send test email immediately
  • 🗑 Archive — Deactivate template

6.3 Create New Template

Click on + New Template at the top right. A dialog opens with three start options:

  • Empty Template — Write HTML from scratch. For completely custom design.
  • Corporate Skeleton — Starts with a ready-made abcona header (blue, with logo) and standard footer. You only fill the middle content area. Recommended for all abcona CI-compliant emails.
  • Duplicate — Use an existing template as a starting point. Ideal for similar variants (e.g., upload_received → upload_error).

Required fields: Display name, Subject (variables allowed: {name}), Identifier (technical code name — cannot be changed after first save!), App area, Status.

6.4 Sender Modes

USER — From = logged-in employee (e.g., angelo@abcona.de), signature automatically from user profile. Recommended for personal consultant emails.

TEMPLATE — Fixed configured sender address (e.g., info@abcona.de). For newsletters and general info emails.

AUTO — From = noreply@abcona.de, no signature, X-Auto-Response-Suppress set. For all automated system emails (upload confirmations, pipeline status, technical notifications).

6.5 HTML Editor

The editor has three views: Visual (edit blocks by clicking), Code (direct HTML editing), TXT (automatically generated from HTML when saving — never maintain manually).

6.6 Variables

Syntax: {variable_name} — replaced with actual values when sending.

  • From Context (blue): {name}, {first_name}, {last_name}, {email}, {cv_link}, {cv_version}, {created_date}, {task_ref} — passed by the calling app
  • User Profile (green): {sender_name}, {sender_email}, {reply_to} — automatically from logged-in user
  • System (gray): {portal_url}, {date}, {year}, {subject} — always available

Clicking on a variable chip in the sidebar inserts the variable at the cursor position. New variables do not need to be registered — simply write them in the template and pass them in the variables={} dictionary in the Python code.

6.7 Modules

Modules are ready-made HTML blocks managed centrally. Syntax: {{block:identifier}}. If a module is changed, it changes automatically in all templates that use it.

Available: Header Blue/Green/Red · Footer Standard/Auto-Reply · Button Blue/Green (requires {button_text} and {button_url}) · Support Contact

Insert: Position cursor → Click module in sidebar → Placeholder appears immediately in code.

6.8 Version History & Milestones

Each save automatically creates a new version with a timestamp. Via the blue bar in the Studio:

  • Change Note — Brief description before saving (e.g., "Logo updated")
  • Mark — Mark current version as a milestone (📌)
  • Restore — Jump back to an older version (current one remains as backup)
  • Undo / Redo — Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, up to 20 steps

6.9 Live Preview & Test Email

The right column shows the email in real time. Switch between Outlook, Gmail, and TXT. Compatibility is displayed below (Outlook ✓, Gmail ✓, Apple ✓, Web.de ✓, TXT ✓, GMX ⚠).

Test Email: Sidebar → "Send test email" → Enter address → Click send icon. Or "Send test" at the top right.

6.10 Translations

DE is always the reference language. Process: Translations → Languages → Set checkmark → Auto-translate → Check and manually edit if necessary (✏).

Variables like {name} are never translated. When sending, the recipient's language is automatically selected. If a translation is missing, it is automatically generated and saved on the first send.

6.11 Duplicate Template

Click the 📋 symbol in the template overview. A dialog opens for the new template. The identifier must be unique. All content (HTML, TXT, variables, modules, settings) is completely copied.

6.12 Send Log

Tab "Send Log": all sent emails with recipient, subject, template, sender, mode, reference, time, and status. Filterable by status, time period, and template. app_reference in the Python code helps with filtering and debugging.

6.13 Python API

from apps.abpe_email_studio.api import EmailStudio

EmailStudio.send(
    template       = 'cv_generated_berater',   # Identifier of the template
    recipient      = 'max@example.de',
    variables      = {'name': 'Max', 'cv_link': 'https://...'},
    user           = request.user,             # for USER mode
    task_reference = 'AID-12345',
    app_reference  = 'cv_extractor',           # for Send Log
    async_send     = False,                    # True = Celery-Queue
    lang           = 'de'                      # optional
)

6.14 Configuration (Administrators only)

Tab "Configuration": SMTP settings (Server, Port, TLS, Test connection), Sender accounts for TEMPLATE mode, Signature management (Standard, Public, User-assigned), and API example code.

6.15 Frequently Asked Questions

Test email not arriving? Check Send Log → if "Failed": Configuration → Test connection.

Change identifier afterwards? Not possible — duplicate template with new identifier, archive old one.

Add new variable? Simply write {new_variable} in the template and pass it in the variables={} dictionary in the Python code.

Translation missing? It is automatically generated and saved on the first send.
